The simplest Rift Echo — bones animated by residual Veil energy with no memory imprint at all. Rift-skeletons form in large numbers wherever mass death occurred near Rift pools; they are the background radiation of the Severed Lands, dangerous only in numbers or when directed by a stronger Echo.
## Actions

**Shortsword.** Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
**Shortbow.** Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
